responsibility: Implements the portable Storage wrapper by delegating allocation, deallocation, reallocation, and availability checks to the lower-level SysStorage module. Its responsibility is to provide the canonical Modula-2 runtime heap API used throughout pge-boot without owning platform-specific memory management policy itself.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file provides the executable wrapper bodies for the Storage API by forwarding each operation to GSysStorage. In contrast, GStorage.h only declares the allocation interface and does not contain the delegation logic.
